def modify_features(X, history):
    # Compute purchase count and average price for each customer in the past 180 days
    customer_history = history[history['days_ago'] <= 180].pivot_table(index='customer_id', values='price', aggfunc=['sum','mean'], fill_value=0)
    customer_history.columns = [f'customer_{col}_purchase_count', f'customer_{col}_average_price' for col in customer_history.columns]
    
    # Compute purchase count for each customer in the past 180 days
    purchase_counts = history[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['article_id'].nunique().to_frame('customer_purchase_count').reset_index()
    
    # Compute article frequency for each customer in the past 180 days
    article_frequencies = history[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['article_id'].count().to_frame('customer_article_frequency').reset_index()
    
    # Merge purchased articles, purchase counts and article frequencies into one DataFrame
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, purchase_counts[['customer_id', 'customer_purchase_count']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, article_frequencies[['customer_id', 'customer_article_frequency']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    
    # Compute average age for each customer in the past 180 days
    customer_ages = history[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['customer_age'].mean().to_frame('customer_average_age').reset_index()
    
    # Merge average age into customer history
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, customer_ages[['customer_id', 'customer_average_age']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    
    # Replace NaN values with 0
    customer_history = customer_history.replace({np.nan: 0})
    
    # Compute mean and std of article frequency for each customer in the past 180 days
    article_frequency_means = customer_history.groupby('customer_id')['customer_article_frequency'].mean().to_frame('customer_article_frequency_mean').reset_index()
    article_frequency_stds = customer_history.groupby('customer_id')['customer_article_frequency'].std().to_frame('customer_article_frequency_std').reset_index()
    
    # Merge article frequency mean and std into customer history
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, article_frequency_means[['customer_id', 'customer_article_frequency_mean']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, article_frequency_stds[['customer_id', 'customer_article_frequency_std']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    
    # Compute mean and std of article average price for each customer in the past 180 days
    article_average_prices = customer_history.groupby('customer_id')[f'customer_{customer_history.columns[1]}_average_price'].mean().to_frame('customer_average_price').reset_index()
    article_average_price_stds = customer_history.groupby('customer_id')[f'customer_{customer_history.columns[1]}_average_price'].std().to_frame('customer_average_price_std').reset_index()
    
    # Merge article average price mean and std into customer history
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, article_average_prices[['customer_id', 'customer_average_price']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    customer_history = pd.merge(customer_history, article_average_price_stds[['customer_id', 'customer_average_price_std']], on='customer_id', how='left')
    
    # Merge customer history into original X DataFrame
    F = customer_history[['customer_id', 'article_id']].copy().set_index(['customer_id', 'article_id'])
    F = F.merge(customer_history[['customer_purchase_count', 'customer_average_age', 'customer_article_frequency', 'customer_article_frequency_mean', 'customer_article_frequency_std', 'customer_average_price', 'customer_average_price_mean', 'customer_average_price_std']].reset_index(), left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')
    
    # Compute aggregates
    F['f_customer_purchase_count'] = F['customer_purchase_count']
    F['f_customer_article_frequency'] = F['customer_article_frequency']
    F['f_customer_average_age'] = F['customer_average_age']
    F['f_customer_article_frequency_mean'] = F['customer_article_frequency_mean']
    F['f_customer_article_frequency_std'] = F['customer_article_frequency_std']
    F['f_customer_average_price'] = F['customer_average_price']
    F['f_customer_average_price_mean'] = F['customer_average_price_mean']
    F['f_customer_average_price_std'] = F['customer_average_price_std']
    
    # Filter out rows where customer_id and article_id are not present in X
    F = F[F['customer_id'].isin(X['customer_id']) & F['article_id'].isin(X['article_id'])].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return F
